adaptations: Reverse mode (protein -> ranked reactions) implemented in models/horizyn/predict_reactions.py with the authors' encoders, featurizer classes and checkpoint: the public repo (823a205) only ships reaction -> protein search (scripts/predict.py); the paper describes the reverse use (Fig. 1C) without code.
Reaction universe = the 11,797 reactions of the released dataset (train + test), not the 15,814 Rhea reactions the paper ranks in its reverse-mode case studies (user decision 2026-11-12).

Score = cosine of the L2-normalised 512-d embeddings with the reaction embedding averaged over the stored and the reversed SMILES direction, identical to scripts/predict.py --bidirectional (training used both directions as positives). Forward and reverse matrices are kept in the raw output.

Protein ProtT5-XL-half embeddings are computed in the run (the authors' embedding code is not released): Rostlab preprocessing, final-layer mean pooling, 5,000-residue chunks averaged (paper); dtype and pooling are SELECTED by validation against the authors' prots_t5.h5 (8 proteins, cosine >= 0.999 and relative L2 <= 0.05) and recorded in versions.json; no scores without a passing variant.
torch 2.7.0+cu128 instead of 2.4.0+cu121 (no aarch64 CUDA build of 2.4); transformers 4.57.1 + sentencepiece added for ProtT5.
Checkpoint loaded with torch.load(weights_only=True) + HorizynLitModule(**hyper_parameters) .load_state_dict(strict=True), equivalent to HorizynLitModule.load_from_checkpoint.

high_conf_set.description: Union of the ECs of every reaction scoring >= 0.72, the paper's "High Confidence" tier (1st percentile of positive training pairs; Materials and Methods, Model Confidence Heuristic). No reaction >= 0.72 -> no_prediction (abstention). Set-valued, so it can credit multifunctional enzymes; the tier was defined on per-direction pair scores and is applied here to the bidirectional score.

top1.description: ECs of the single highest-scoring reaction; if it has no EC in rhea2ec the protein is unmappable (strict reading of the model's top prediction).

top1_with_ec.description: ECs (rhea2ec, Rhea 143) of the highest-scoring reaction that has >=1 EC; reactions without EC above it are skipped (--first-with-ec rule of the lab's earlier pipeline). Primary variant.
